verdict.reason: Neither cohort reaches 8.0 on exact means (admin-console 7.61, settings 7.8666...). Round1's actionable findings are fixed in the pixels; remaining drag is Logs (UA-size 'Log sources' h2, second filled action, bare empty states), app-detail section hierarchy and empty Checks column, the phone Alerts mono 'Reason:' label, and Backup's success-green badges on an unconfigured state plus the lack of an enabled next step in view.
